description: Harness -> browser events. Run each `wire` text through the browser's event check with `receiver` and expect `expect`: "ok", "duplicate" (drop silently), "ignored_unknown_op" (verified, seq advanced, not rendered) or a rejection code. Order: protocol.md 5.7. Events have no ts window (they can be replayed from the 10-minute buffer).
